beginner.why: The pipe, annulus and pump pressures need the capstone mud, which no explorer took, and printed in MPa to 4 dp (100 Pa) against tol 50 Pa; the Herschel-Bulkley yield rule was not taught. W4a adds Your mud boxes (four readings and a density, blank is the case's own mud) to all three explorers, prints pressures in MPa to 6 dp, and teaches the yield rule in beginner m02 l04. The brief now names the boxes. Prompt only.
prompt_edits: Use the Herschel-Bulkley fit for the pressure calculation, which is what the engine does.

Use the Herschel-Bulkley fit for the pressure calculation, which is what the engine does. Type this mud into the rheology explorer's Your mud boxes: its model view fits it and its pressure chain view prints the four pressures in MPa to six decimals.
